name: dsh-cua-driver-indicator
description: Visibility layer for DSH's built-in Cua Driver channel (cua_driver_native__*): shows a non-activating screen-edge banner and pointer halo while the official tools operate the desktop, turns a physical Esc into a real stop, and when that official channel is missing it asks in the web UI whether to install it (one-click install through the host's own pipeline, a real verification afterwards, and a restart left to the user). It also adds four precision tools for the desktop: cua_snap_click (checks that the point is not covered, verifies what the click changed and retries once), cua_snap_click_named (finds a control by its name), cua_snap_sequence (up to five clicks in a row) and cua_snap_wait_for (waits for a control to show up); controls can be addressed by element id and run in the background when the application supports it. Windows only.
